statement: Guide on spending post office boxes based on his opinion and Twitch chat; two phases: early-mid and late game.
Early to mid game is about 800 post boxes or less; late game is 800 plus.
Early game: level the Civil War box to 200 first.
Civil War box gives base damage AFK gains and crit chance; mostly used for fight AFK gains.
Fight AFK gains from the box are practically bad late game (garbled).

subsystem: post office boxes of wanted stats
statement: Skip the box with base defense accuracy and monster XP because flurbos from party dungeons easily provide those stats.
Flurbos acquired from party dungeons can be spent to get base defense base accuracy and monster XP.
Archers put 200 boxes in the smithing box.
Warriors put 200 boxes in the mining box.
Mages put 200 boxes in the chopping box.
Skilling boxes picked this way will still be used in late game.
After reaching 200 in the skilling box max it to 400.

subsystem: post office care package for mum
statement: Then prioritize Care Package for Mum to about 200 which reaches 800 boxes spent.

subsystem: post office care package for mum
statement: Care Package is underrated and very powerful late game since it does not consume food.

subsystem: post office alchemy fishing catching box
statement: Fishing and catching boxes are not a priority early or late; full AFK gains are possible without them.
Alchemy box is an optional choice later in the game but not a priority to spend boxes on.
Maestro and Journeyman should instantly put all post office boxes into the Non-Predatory Loot Box.
Non-Predatory Loot Box gives drop rarity luck and crystal mob spawn.
Journeyman should also instantly put all boxes into the Non-Predatory Loot Box.
Maestro split: 400 into Non-Predatory Loot Box and 200 into Care Package for Mum.
Late game Civil War box base damage becomes irrelevant except for fight AFK gains; could still use it.
Late game with three main skillers put 400 in each respective skilling box.
Death storage box is by far the strongest; invest 400 in it for weapon power attack speed and total damage.
Death storage helps progress through world three and soon world four.
Level up Ulian Capsule box: gives percent printer sample percent multi-kill and percent cash from mobs.
Ulian Capsule is a mid-max tool making late game a breeze.
Once main boxes are maxed you are free to branch into alchemy construction worship or trapping.
Squire can go construction; wizard worship; hunter trapping after main boxes are done.
Late game alchemy is the true late game so prioritize spending money on it.
Early recap: 200 Civil War box 400 respective skilling box 200 care package for mum.
Maestro recap: instantly 400 non-predatory loot box and 200 care package for mum.
Late recap: 400 world one skilling box 400 death storage and 200 care package for mum.
Prioritize Ulian Capsule over getting care package to 400 to get 3D prints out for farming later.

subsystem: post office care package for mum
statement: Care package can eventually reach 400 but it takes long.
He calculated about 1400 boxes for the full setup.
Following this setup means you won't need to spend gems to respec boxes.
Post office is daunting especially needing gems to respec.
